selected_premise.logline: The Inspector treats a friend's 'seen' with no reply as a failure of public infrastructure, until an off-camera voice reminds her she has left her own sister on seen since Tuesday.
selected_premise.payoff: She pronounces the case closed, then quietly starts typing a reply to her sister, committing the very fault she just prosecuted.

hook.first_frame: Tight on the Inspector's composed face under a desk lamp, a phone held up like evidence, its screen a blank glow with no readable text.

script.title: The Seen
script.synopsis: In a tidy study, the Inspector formally investigates a message that was delivered, read, and never answered. She declares it negligence. An off-camera voice points out her own unanswered message from her sister. She deflects, closes the case, and is caught drafting a reply.

beats.beat: Inspector opens the case file on a 'seen' with no reply, phone held as evidence.
She lays out the timeline and calls it a failure of infrastructure.
Her certainty grows as she sets the evidence tag and marks the offender negligent.
Off-camera voice: her sister messaged Tuesday and she has seen it.
She deflects: 'different, I was drafting', then stamps the case closed.
She slips out to the balcony and starts typing, guilty and composed.
Direct line to the viewer: who has been leaving you on seen? Follow for the next case.

scenes.location: The Inspector's study: a neat wooden desk with a green banker's lamp, a corkboard behind her
scenes.action: She holds the phone up level with her eyes like an exhibit, then lays it flat on a labelled evidence card and taps a pen beside it, reciting the timeline.
scenes.performance: Calm, clipped, officially grave; every word delivered like a charge sheet.
scenes.microexpression: One eyebrow lifts at 'No reply'; a tiny tightening of the jaw.
dialogue: Case file: the Seen. Delivered at noon. Read at twelve-oh-one. No reply.

camera.shot: Medium close-up, centered, phone in foreground
camera.movement: Slow push-in of a few centimetres

scenes.lighting: Warm key from the banker's lamp, cool soft fill from a window, gentle shadow on the corkboard
scenes.environment: Corkboard with unreadable index cards and red string, a mug of pens, a brass desk bell; phone screen shows only abstract blank glow, no logos or text

sound.ambience: quiet room tone, faint clock tick

scenes.transition_out: Hard cut on the pen tap to a slightly tighter angle

scenes.action: She pins a paper tag marked with a simple clock icon to the corkboard, then turns back to camera and rings the desk bell once for emphasis.
scenes.performance: Rising righteous certainty, still composed, a touch theatrical on 'infrastructure'.
scenes.microexpression: Nostrils flare slightly with indignation; eyes narrow, then a satisfied small nod.
dialogue: Read in a minute. Ignored all day. This is a failure of infrastructure.

camera.shot: Close-up, slightly lower angle for authority
camera.movement: Static, with a tiny handheld settle on the bell ring

scenes.lighting: Same warm lamp key, slightly more contrast on her face
scenes.environment: Same study; the tagged corkboard now visible over her shoulder
scenes.transition_out: Cut on the lingering bell ring to the off-camera interruption

scenes.action: An off-camera voice speaks; the Inspector freezes mid-gesture, glances down at her own phone lighting up beside the case file, then recovers and straightens her papers.
scenes.performance: Sudden stillness, then stiff dignified deflection; speaks too quickly on 'drafting'.
scenes.microexpression: Eyes flick sideways and down; a swallow; mouth presses thin before the excuse.
dialogue: Off-camera voice: Inspector. Your sister messaged. Tuesday. You've seen it.
Inspector: That is different. I was drafting.

camera.movement: Slow creeping push-in as she freezes

scenes.lighting: Phone glow adds a cool pool under her chin against the warm lamp
scenes.environment: Same study; a second small tag labelled with a heart icon is visible, curling off the corkboard edge

sound.ambience: room tone, clock tick, pause in sound as she freezes

scenes.transition_out: Match cut on her turning away from desk toward the balcony door

scenes.location: Small balcony outside the study, dusk light, city rooftops blurred behind
scenes.action: She steps out, stamps 'CLOSED' on the case card held in one hand, then lifts the phone and begins typing a reply with one finger, glancing at the lens as she speaks.
scenes.performance: Dry composure cracking into a faint guilty smile; the call to action is delivered straight to viewer.
scenes.microexpression: A tiny sheepish lip twitch while typing; eyes meet the lens with conspiratorial calm.
dialogue: Case closed. Who's been leaving you on seen? Follow.

camera.shot: Medium shot to close-up, eye level, through the open balcony door frame
camera.movement: Gentle slow push-in, holding on her face at the final word

scenes.lighting: Soft golden-blue dusk key, practical warm glow from the study behind her
scenes.environment: Balcony railing, a potted plant, blurred skyline with no readable signage

sound.ambience: soft city air, distant traffic hush

continuity.identity_anchors: Woman in her late 30s, dark hair pulled into a tight low bun, sharp composed expression, small round tortoiseshell glasses, same face and voice throughout.
continuity.costume: Charcoal tailored blazer over a cream blouse, thin dark tie loosened by one notch from S3 onward, small brass lapel pin.
continuity.notes: Only the Inspector appears on camera; the second voice is off-camera and unseen. Two locations only: study and balcony. No real app logos or readable UI text; phone screens show only abstract glow. No statistics about messaging behaviour are stated. Speech totals roughly 47 words across 20 seconds, around 2.4 words per second.
